name: PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk
summary: PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk manufactures and sells precision fasteners and engineered components primarily for the automotive industry in Indonesia, rest of Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company offers bolts, nuts, screws, and rivets; and special components, and pins and collars for use in engine, suspension, brake, interior, power train, and other applications. It also serves motorcycles, automobile, automotive components, electrical equipment, steel rolling, plating service, iron and steel and home appliance industries. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Jakarta Utara, Indonesia. PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Garuda Multi Investama.
